title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Database exports are now significantly faster and more reliable
summary: Microsoft is rolling out an Admin Center update that makes Business Central database exports much faster and more reliable, with failures under 1% even for large environments. The Export History page is being removed: exports are now tracked on the Operations page, which also shows error details. Anyone reading export history through the Admin Center APIs should switch to the environment Operations endpoints.
key_points: Database exports are now significantly faster and more reliable with failure rates below 1%
Export History page is being removed; export progress tracking moves to the Operations page
Admin Center APIs for export history must migrate to environment Operations endpoints
BACPAC files are exported to Azure storage containers via Admin Center
